decisions.choice: the oracles against the nations: chapters 25-32
decisions.reason: With Jerusalem under siege (24:1-2) and its fall still to be reported (33:21), the book turns to seven of Israel's neighbors: Ammon, Moab, Edom and the Philistines (chapter 25), Tyre (26:1-28:19), Sidon (28:20-26) and Egypt (29-32). Isaiah 13-23, Jeremiah 46-51 and Amos 1-2 have collections like it. The four short oracles of this chapter follow one pattern: "because" (what the nation did when Judah fell), "therefore" (what the LORD will do), and "you will know that I am the LORD".

decisions.choice: The word of the LORD came to me, saying (L); came to me (B); The LORD gave me this message (R)
decisions.reason: The formula follows the wording set in the Jeremiah table, as in 17:1.

decisions.choice: the oracles against the nations (25-32) as speech: present, future and passé composé at every level; the word-formula heading in the passé simple at L and B ("me fut adressée") and the passé composé at R ("m'a donné ce message")
decisions.reason: French style guide §3 and the term sheet for Ezekiel: oracles are speech, Ezekiel's frame is first-person narrative. Recorded once for chapters 25-33.

decisions.choice: "Neno la BWANA likanijia, kusema:" (L); "Neno la BWANA likanijia:" (B); "BWANA alinipa ujumbe huu:" (R)
decisions.reason: The formula as the Swahili Ezekiel and Jeremiah have it; recorded once for this block of chapters (25-33). The oracle that follows takes no quotation marks.

decisions.choice: Vino a mí la palabra del SEÑOR, diciendo (L); La palabra del SEÑOR vino a mí (B); El SEÑOR me dio este mensaje (R)
decisions.reason: The formula keeps the wording of Spanish Jeremiah and of the earlier chapters of Ezekiel at each level, here at the head of the oracles against the nations (25-32).

decisions.choice: "{{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 말씀이 나에게 임하여 말씀하셨다" (L), "…임했다" (B), "{{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 나에게 이 말씀을 주셨다" (R) for the word-event formula, throughout chapters 25-33; the narrator gives God the honorific (-시-, 께서) at every level, and Korean has no deity_pronoun spans
decisions.reason: The formula of the Isaiah-Jeremiah term sheet, as in Ezekiel 1-24. Ezekiel narrates in the first person in the plain written style; respect for God is carried by the honorific, since Korean has no capital letters for the deity_pronoun setting to change (Korean style guide 7).

decisions.choice: son of man: a mortal, as God addresses Ezekiel
decisions.reason: See the note at 2:1.

decisions.choice: set your face toward: turn toward them, as a sign of the message against them
decisions.reason: See the note at 6:2. Ezekiel is in Babylonia, far from Ammon; turning toward a people marks the word as aimed at them.

decisions.choice: the sons of Ammon: the Ammonites, east of the Jordan
decisions.reason: The Ammonites lived on the edge of the desert east of the Jordan, around their capital Rabbah (verse 5). They traced their descent to Lot (Genesis 19:38) and were often at war with Israel (Judges 11; 2 Samuel 10). In 21:23-37 Nebuchadnezzar chose between Jerusalem and Rabbah, and Ammon was promised its own judgment (21:33-37).

decisions.choice: the children of Ammon (L, gender default); the Ammonites (B, R)
decisions.reason: Literal follows Jeremiah 49:1 and Zephaniah 2:8, with the gender setting, since the whole people is meant. Balanced and Readable use the name of the people. "Set your face toward" follows the settled wording ("turn to face" at Balanced, "turn toward" at Readable).

decisions.choice: "fils d'homme" (lowercase, every level) and *sim panekha 'el* "tourne ta face vers" (L), "tourne ton regard vers" (B), "tourne-toi vers" (R), for chapters 25-33
decisions.reason: The settled French formulas of Ezekiel (2:1; 6:2); "fils de l'homme" is kept for Jesus's title.

decisions.choice: "mwana wa binadamu", lowercase, at every level
decisions.reason: God's address to Ezekiel, kept apart from Jesus' title "Mwana wa Adamu" by its lowercase and wording, as in the earlier chapters of Ezekiel.

decisions.choice: "wana wa Amoni" (L); "Waamoni" (B, R), with no gender span; "kaza uso wako kuelekea" (L), "geuka uwaelekee" (B, R)
decisions.reason: Swahili "wana" covers sons and daughters, so the English gender setting has nothing to change here; the idiom of setting the face follows the Ezekiel table.

decisions.choice: hijo de hombre at every level, lowercase
decisions.reason: God's address to Ezekiel is 'hijo de hombre' at every level, never the Gospels' title 'Hijo del Hombre'; it is capitalized here only because it opens the sentence. Recorded once for chapters 25-33.

decisions.choice: los hijos de Amón (L); los amonitas (B, R), with no gender span
decisions.reason: 'Los hijos de Amón' is the published Spanish name of the people and already includes women, so the English gender span has no Spanish counterpart; 'pon tu rostro hacia / vuélvete de cara a / vuélvete hacia' keeps the book's wording at each level.

decisions.choice: "사람의 아들아" for God's address to Ezekiel (ben-adam), at every level, with no gender span
decisions.reason: As decided at 2:1: 인자 is Jesus's title in the Korean New Testament, while Ezekiel's address means only "human being", so it is kept plain. Ezekiel is one man, so no gender span.

decisions.choice: "암몬 {{gender:자손|아들들}}" at Literal; "암몬 사람들" (B, R)
decisions.reason: As Ezekiel 21:25 and 21:33: the inclusive 자손 is the default and 아들들 the word-for-word alternative where the English Literal has its gender span; Balanced and Readable say "the Ammonites" with no span.

records.literal_gloss: and you will say to [the] sons of Ammon: Hear [the] word of [the] Lord Yahweh. Thus says [the] Lord Yahweh: Because you said, Aha! concerning my sanctuary, when it was profaned, and concerning the land of Israel, when it was made desolate, and concerning the house of Judah, when they went into exile,

en.L: and say to the {{gender:children|sons}} of Ammon, Hear the word of the Lord {{divine_name:GOD|Yahweh}}. Thus says the Lord {{divine_name:GOD|Yahweh}}: Because you said, "Aha!" over {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} sanctuary when it was profaned, and over the land of Israel when it was made desolate, and over the house of Judah when they went into exile,
en.B: and say to the Ammonites, Hear the word of the Lord {{divine_name:GOD|Yahweh}}! The Lord {{divine_name:GOD|Yahweh}} says this: Because you cried "Aha!" over {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} sanctuary when it was desecrated, over the land of Israel when it was laid waste, and over the people of Judah when they went into exile,
en.R: Say to them, Listen to the message of the Lord {{divine_name:GOD|Yahweh}}. This is what the Lord {{divine_name:GOD|Yahweh}} says: You cheered and said "Aha!" when {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} temple was made unclean, when the land of Israel was ruined, and when the people of Judah were taken away as captives.

fr.L: et dis aux {{gender:enfants|fils}} d’Ammon : Écoutez la parole du Seigneur {{divine_name:DIEU|Yahvé}}. Ainsi parle le Seigneur {{divine_name:DIEU|Yahvé}} : Parce que tu as dit « Ha ha ! » au sujet de {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} sanctuaire quand il a été profané, et au sujet de la terre d’Israël quand elle a été dévastée, et au sujet de la maison de Juda quand ils sont allés en exil,

Le Seigneur {{divine_name:DIEU|Yahvé}} dit ceci : Parce que tu as crié « Ha ha ! » sur {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} sanctuaire quand il a été profané, sur la terre d’Israël quand elle a été ravagée, et sur le peuple de Juda quand il est parti en exil,
fr.R: Dis-leur : Écoutez le message du Seigneur {{divine_name:DIEU|Yahvé}}. Voici ce que dit le Seigneur {{divine_name:DIEU|Yahvé}} : Vous vous êtes réjouis et vous avez dit « Ha ha ! » quand {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} temple a été rendu impur, quand la terre d’Israël a été ruinée, et quand les gens de Juda ont été emmenés en captivité.

sw.L: nawe uwaambie wana wa Amoni, Sikieni neno la Bwana {{divine_name:MUNGU|Yahwe}}. Bwana {{divine_name:MUNGU|Yahwe}} asema hivi: Kwa sababu ulisema, "Aha!" juu ya patakatifu {{deity_pronoun:wangu|Wangu}} palipotiwa unajisi, na juu ya nchi ya Israeli ilipofanywa ukiwa, na juu ya nyumba ya Yuda walipokwenda uhamishoni,

Hivi ndivyo Bwana {{divine_name:MUNGU|Yahwe}} asemavyo: Kwa kuwa ulipiga kelele, "Aha!" juu ya patakatifu {{deity_pronoun:wangu|Wangu}} palipotiwa unajisi, juu ya nchi ya Israeli ilipoharibiwa, na juu ya watu wa Yuda walipochukuliwa uhamishoni,
sw.R: Waambie, Sikilizeni ujumbe huu kutoka kwa Bwana {{divine_name:MUNGU|Yahwe}}. Hili ndilo Bwana {{divine_name:MUNGU|Yahwe}} analosema: Mlishangilia na kusema, "Aha!" hekalu {{deity_pronoun:wangu|Wangu}} lilipotiwa unajisi, nchi ya Israeli ilipoharibiwa, na watu wa Yuda walipochukuliwa mateka.

es.L: y di a los hijos de Amón: {{plural_you:Oigan|Oíd}} la palabra del Señor {{divine_name:DIOS|Yahvé}}. Así dice el Señor {{divine_name:DIOS|Yahvé}}: Por cuanto dijiste «¡Ajá!» contra {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} santuario cuando fue profanado, y contra la tierra de Israel cuando fue asolada, y contra la casa de Judá cuando fueron al destierro,
es.B: y di a los amonitas: ¡{{plural_you:Escuchen|Escuchad}} la palabra del Señor {{divine_name:DIOS|Yahvé}}! El Señor {{divine_name:DIOS|Yahvé}} dice esto: Porque gritaste «¡Ajá!» sobre {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} santuario cuando fue profanado, sobre la tierra de Israel cuando fue arrasada y sobre el pueblo de Judá cuando fue al destierro,
es.R: Diles: {{plural_you:Escuchen|Escuchad}} el mensaje del Señor {{divine_name:DIOS|Yahvé}}. Esto es lo que dice el Señor {{divine_name:DIOS|Yahvé}}: Tú gritaste de alegría «¡Ajá!» cuando {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} templo fue profanado, cuando la tierra de Israel quedó arruinada y cuando el pueblo de Judá fue llevado cautivo.

ko.L: 그리고 암몬 {{gender:자손|아들들}}에게 말하여라. 주 {{divine_name:하나님|야훼}}의 말씀을 들어라. 주 {{divine_name:하나님|야훼}}께서 이와 같이 말씀하신다. 내 성소가 더럽혀졌을 때에, 이스라엘 땅이 황폐해졌을 때에, 유다 집이 포로로 끌려갔을 때에, 네가 그것을 두고 "아하!" 하고 말하였으므로,
ko.B: 암몬 사람들에게 이렇게 말하여라. 주 {{divine_name:하나님|야훼}}의 말씀을 들어라! 주 {{divine_name:하나님|야훼}}께서 이렇게 말씀하신다. 내 성소가 더럽혀졌을 때, 이스라엘 땅이 황폐해졌을 때, 유다 백성이 포로로 끌려갔을 때, 네가 그것을 보고 "아하!" 하고 소리쳤으므로,
ko.R: 그들에게 말하여라. 주 {{divine_name:하나님|야훼}}께서 하시는 말씀을 들어라. 주 {{divine_name:하나님|야훼}}께서 하시는 말씀이다. 내 성전이 더럽혀졌을 때, 이스라엘 땅이 망했을 때, 유다 백성이 포로로 끌려갔을 때, 너는 좋아하며 "아하!" 하고 소리쳤다.

decisions.choice: Aha!: a cry of gloating at another's ruin
decisions.reason: The word is a shout of malicious delight (26:2; 36:2; Psalm 35:21, 25). Ammon is condemned not for an attack but for rejoicing at Judah's fall.

decisions.choice: my sanctuary profaned, the land laid waste, Judah exiled: the fall of Jerusalem in 586 BC
decisions.reason: The Babylonians burned the temple, ruined the land and took the people of Judah into exile (2 Kings 25:8-21). The LORD had said that he himself would profane his sanctuary (24:21). The oracle looks back on those events, or speaks of them as certain.

decisions.choice: because ... therefore: the pattern of each oracle in the chapter
decisions.reason: Each of the four oracles names the wrong ("because", here and in verses 6, 8, 12 and 15) and then the sentence ("therefore", verses 4, 7, 9, 13 and 16).

decisions.choice: Thus says the Lord GOD (L); The Lord GOD says this (B); This is what the Lord GOD says (R)
decisions.reason: The settled formula. Under the quotation rule for Ezekiel, the LORD's words take no quotation marks; only human speech quoted inside them takes double quotes.

decisions.choice: my temple ... made unclean
decisions.reason: Readable says "temple" for "sanctuary" and "made unclean" for "profaned", and gives the gloating as a statement of its own before the sentence in verse 4.

decisions.choice: Ammon addressed as "tu" after "Écoutez", following the Hebrew's switch from plural to a feminine singular; R says "vous" throughout, as the English R smooths it
decisions.reason: The term sheet: tu / vous follow the Hebrew's number; Ammon is addressed as one nation (feminine in the Hebrew, but French "Ammon" agrees in the masculine, so no feminine forms are needed here).

decisions.choice: "Bwana MUNGU asema hivi:" (L); "Hivi ndivyo Bwana MUNGU asemavyo:" (B); "Hili ndilo Bwana MUNGU analosema:" (R), with the span on MUNGU only
decisions.reason: The Ezekiel formula for koh 'amar Adonai YHWH, as the term sheet and the earlier chapters have it; "Kwa hiyo" goes in front where the Hebrew has lakhen. Ammon is addressed as "wewe" (one nation) in the oracle, while "Sikieni" is plural to the Ammonites.

decisions.choice: spans only on free pronouns and possessives ("wangu", "mimi", "yangu")
decisions.reason: Swahili marks most pronouns inside the verb, where a capital is impossible, so these chapters have fewer deity_pronoun spans than the English.

decisions.choice: [[Oigan|Oíd]] / [[Escuchen|Escuchad]] plural; then singular 'tú' (dijiste, gritaste)
decisions.reason: The call to hear is plural in the Hebrew, so it takes a plural_you span; from 'Because you said' the Hebrew speaks to Ammon as one (feminine singular), so Spanish turns to 'tú'. The formulas 'Así dice el Señor DIOS' (L), 'El Señor DIOS dice esto' (B), 'Esto es lo que dice el Señor DIOS' (R) hold through these chapters.

decisions.choice: «¡Ajá!»
decisions.reason: The gloating cry is worded as in Spanish Psalms 35:21 and 40:16, and set in « » as human speech inside the oracle.

decisions.choice: "주 {{divine_name:하나님|야훼}}께서 이와 같이 말씀하신다" (L), "…이렇게 말씀하신다" (B), "…께서 하시는 말씀이다" (R) for "Thus says the Lord GOD", ending in a period; "Lord GOD" is 주 with the span {{divine_name:하나님|야훼}}, followed only by particles that read after both forms (께서, 의, 인, 이다)
decisions.reason: The term sheet's wording, used through these chapters. 하나님 ends in a consonant and 야훼 in a vowel, so 이/가, 은/는, 을/를 and the like never follow the span.

source.text: לָכֵ֡ן הִנְנִי֩ נֹתְנָ֨ךְ לִבְנֵי־קֶ֜דֶם לְמֽוֹרָשָׁ֗ה וְיִשְּׁב֤וּ טִירֽוֹתֵיהֶם֙ בָּ֔ךְ וְנָ֥תְנוּ בָ֖ךְ מִשְׁכְּנֵיהֶ֑ם הֵ֚מָּה יֹאכְל֣וּ פִרְיֵ֔ךְ וְהֵ֖מָּה יִשְׁתּ֥וּ חֲלָבֵֽךְ׃

records.literal_gloss: therefore, look, I [am] about to give you to [the] sons of [the] east as a possession, and they will set up their encampments among you and they will put among you their dwellings; they will eat your fruit, and they will drink your milk.

en.L: therefore, look, I am giving you to the {{gender:people|sons}} of the east as a possession, and they will set up their encampments among you and put their dwellings among you; they themselves will eat your fruit, and they themselves will drink your milk.
en.B: therefore I am going to hand you over to the people of the east as their possession. They will set up their camps among you and pitch their tents in your land; they will eat your fruit and drink your milk.
en.R: So I am going to give your land to the desert tribes from the east. They will set up their camps in your land and pitch their tents there. They will eat your fruit and drink your milk.

es.L: por tanto, he aquí, yo te entrego a los hijos del oriente como posesión, y asentarán en ti sus campamentos y pondrán en ti sus moradas; ellos comerán tu fruto, y ellos beberán tu leche.

es.R: Por eso voy a dar tu tierra a las tribus del desierto del oriente. Levantarán sus campamentos en tu tierra y plantarán allí sus tiendas. Comerán tu fruta y beberán tu leche.

ko.L: 그러므로 보라, 내가 너를 동방 사람들에게 넘겨주어 소유가 되게 하겠다. 그들이 네 가운데 진영을 세우고, 네 가운데 그들의 거처를 둘 것이다. 바로 그들이 네 열매를 먹고, 바로 그들이 네 젖을 마실 것이다.
ko.B: 그러므로 내가 너를 동방 사람들에게 넘겨주어 그들의 소유가 되게 하겠다. 그들이 네 땅에 진을 치고 장막을 칠 것이다. 그들이 네 열매를 먹고 네 젖을 마실 것이다.
ko.R: 그래서 나는 네 땅을 동쪽 사막에 사는 부족들에게 주겠다. 그들이 네 땅에 진을 치고 거기에 장막을 칠 것이다. 그들이 네 열매를 먹고 네 젖을 마실 것이다.

decisions.choice: the sons of the east: the nomad tribes of the desert east of Ammon
decisions.reason: The phrase names the desert peoples of the east (Judges 6:3; Jeremiah 49:28). Ammon lay on the edge of the desert, and its land would be overrun by tent-dwelling tribes with their herds.

decisions.choice: encampments: the tent circles or stone enclosures of nomads
decisions.reason: The word is used of the camps of Ishmael's tribes (Genesis 25:16) and of walled rows of stones (46:23). Here it is the camp of herders settling on Ammon's land.

decisions.choice: they will eat your fruit and drink your milk: they will live off your land and herds
decisions.reason: Fruit and milk stand for the produce of farms and flocks. Strangers will enjoy what Ammon worked for.

decisions.choice: the people of the east (L, gender default)
decisions.reason: Literal follows 1 Kings 5:10, with the gender setting; Readable says who they were, as Jeremiah 49:28 does ("the desert tribes").

decisions.choice: "les {{gender:enfants|fils}} de l'Orient" (L); "les peuples de l'Orient" (B); "les tribus du désert" (R)
decisions.reason: As the published Jeremiah 49:28 words *bene qedem*.

decisions.choice: "wana wa mashariki" (L); "watu wa mashariki" (B), with no gender span
decisions.reason: "wana" covers both sexes in Swahili.

decisions.choice: los hijos del oriente (L); los pueblos del oriente (B); las tribus del desierto del oriente (R), with no gender span
decisions.reason: L keeps the published Spanish phrase (Genesis 29:1; Judges 6:3), which already includes women; B and R say who they are, as the English does.

decisions.choice: "동방 사람들" with no gender span
decisions.reason: Korean "사람들" already covers men and women, and "동방 아들들" is not a Korean way of naming a people, so Korean has only one wording here and in 25:10, while the English Literal has a span.

source.text: וְנָתַתִּ֤י אֶת־רַבָּה֙ לִנְוֵ֣ה גְמַלִּ֔ים וְאֶת־בְּנֵ֥י עַמּ֖וֹן לְמִרְבַּץ־צֹ֑אן וִֽידַעְתֶּ֖ם כִּֽי־אֲנִ֥י יְהוָֽה׃ס

records.literal_gloss: And I will make Rabbah into a pasture of camels and [the] sons of Ammon into a resting place of flocks; and you will know that I [am] Yahweh.

en.L: And I will make Rabbah a pasture of camels, and the {{gender:children|sons}} of Ammon a place where flocks lie down; and you will know that I [am] {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}.
en.B: I will turn Rabbah into a pasture for camels and the land of Ammon into a fold for sheep. Then you will know that I am {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}.
en.R: I will turn the city of Rabbah into a pasture for camels and the land of Ammon into a place where sheep lie down. Then you will know that I am {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}.

fr.L: Et je ferai de Rabba un pâturage de chameaux, et des {{gender:enfants|fils}} d’Ammon un lieu où se couchent les troupeaux ; et vous saurez que je [suis] {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}.
fr.B: Je ferai de Rabba un pâturage pour les chameaux et du pays d’Ammon un enclos pour les moutons. Alors vous saurez que je suis {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}.
fr.R: Je transformerai la ville de Rabba en pâturage pour les chameaux, et le pays d’Ammon en un lieu où les moutons se reposent. Alors vous saurez que je suis {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}.

sw.L: Nami nitaufanya Raba kuwa malisho ya ngamia, na wana wa Amoni kuwa mahali pa kupumzikia makundi ya kondoo; nanyi mtajua kwamba {{deity_pronoun:mimi|Mimi}} [ni] {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}.
sw.B: Nitaugeuza Raba kuwa malisho ya ngamia na nchi ya Amoni kuwa zizi la kondoo. Ndipo mtajua kwamba {{deity_pronoun:mimi|Mimi}} ndimi {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}.
sw.R: Nitaugeuza mji wa Raba kuwa malisho ya ngamia, na nchi ya Amoni kuwa mahali ambapo kondoo hulala. Ndipo mtajua kwamba {{deity_pronoun:mimi|Mimi}} ni {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}.

es.L: Y haré de Rabá un pastizal de camellos, y de los hijos de Amón una majada de ovejas; y {{plural_you:sabrán|sabréis}} que yo [soy] {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}.
es.B: Convertiré a Rabá en un pastizal para camellos, y la tierra de Amón en un redil para ovejas. Entonces {{plural_you:sabrán|sabréis}} que yo soy {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}.
es.R: Convertiré la ciudad de Rabá en un pastizal para camellos, y la tierra de Amón en un lugar donde descansan las ovejas. Entonces {{plural_you:sabrán|sabréis}} que yo soy {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}.

ko.L: 그리고 내가 랍바를 낙타들의 목장으로, 암몬 {{gender:자손|아들들}}을 양 떼가 눕는 곳으로 만들겠다. 그리고 너희는 내가 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}인 줄 알 것이다.
ko.B: 내가 랍바를 낙타의 목장으로, 암몬 땅을 양 떼의 우리로 만들겠다. 그러면 너희는 내가 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}인 줄 알게 될 것이다.
ko.R: 내가 랍바 성을 낙타들이 풀을 뜯는 곳으로, 암몬 땅을 양들이 쉬는 곳으로 만들겠다. 그러면 너희는 내가 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}인 줄 알게 될 것이다.

decisions.choice: Rabbah: the capital of the Ammonites
decisions.reason: Rabbah stood where the city of Amman, in Jordan, is today (2 Samuel 12:26; Jeremiah 49:2).

decisions.choice: a pasture for camels, a resting place for flocks: a city emptied of its people
decisions.reason: When a city is left empty, herds graze where its people lived (Isaiah 17:2; 32:14; Zephaniah 2:6, 14).

decisions.choice: and you will know that I am the LORD: now said to the nations
decisions.reason: The words that end so many of the LORD's sentences on Israel (see 6:7) are now said to Israel's neighbors. The nations too will learn by what happens that the LORD is God and has done it.

decisions.choice: the land of Ammon
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable say "the land of Ammon" for "the sons of Ammon", because the line pairs the people with the city and speaks of the place where flocks will rest.

decisions.choice: and you will know that I am the LORD (L); Then you will know (B, R)
decisions.reason: The refrain follows the settled wording for Ezekiel; see the note at 6:7.

decisions.choice: "et vous saurez que je [suis] le SEIGNEUR" (L); "Alors vous saurez que je suis le SEIGNEUR" (B, R); "tu sauras", "ils sauront" as the Hebrew has it, for chapters 25-33
decisions.reason: The settled French wording of Ezekiel's refrain (6:7).

decisions.choice: "nanyi mtajua kwamba mimi [ni] BWANA" (L); "Ndipo mtajua kwamba mimi ndimi BWANA" (B); "Ndipo mtajua kwamba mimi ni BWANA" (R)
decisions.reason: The Ezekiel refrain as the term sheet and Exodus 6:7 have it; "watajua" where the Hebrew has "they", "utajua" for singular "you".

decisions.choice: y [[sabrán|sabréis]] que yo [soy] el SEÑOR (L); Entonces [[sabrán|sabréis]] que yo soy el SEÑOR (B, R)
decisions.reason: The Hebrew 'you will know' is plural here, the Ammonites, so it takes a plural_you span; the refrain keeps one wording at each level through the book, and is singular 'sabrás' where the Hebrew is singular (verse 7).

decisions.choice: "그리고 너희는 내가 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}인 줄 알 것이다" (L); "그러면 너희는 내가 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}인 줄 알게 될 것이다" (B, R), with 너, 너희 or 그들 as the Hebrew has it
decisions.reason: The term sheet's recognition formula, as 1 Kings 20:13, used through chapters 25-33.

source.text: כִּ֣י כֹ֤ה אָמַר֙ אֲדֹנָ֣י יְהוִ֔ה יַ֚עַן מַחְאֲךָ֣ יָ֔ד וְרַקְעֲךָ֖ בְּרָ֑גֶל וַתִּשְׂמַ֤ח בְּכָל־שָֽׁאטְךָ֙ בְּנֶ֔פֶשׁ אֶל־אַדְמַ֖ת יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃

records.literal_gloss: For thus says [the] Lord Yahweh: Because you clapped [your] hand and stamped [your] foot, and rejoiced with all your contempt in [your] soul concerning [the] land of Israel,

en.L: For thus says the Lord {{divine_name:GOD|Yahweh}}: Because you clapped [your] hand and stamped [your] foot and rejoiced with all the contempt of [your] soul over the land of Israel,
en.B: For the Lord {{divine_name:GOD|Yahweh}} says this: Because you clapped your hands and stamped your feet and gloated with all the scorn in your heart over the land of Israel,
en.R: This is what the Lord {{divine_name:GOD|Yahweh}} says: You clapped your hands and stamped your feet. You were glad that the land of Israel was ruined, and you were full of scorn for it.

fr.L: Car ainsi parle le Seigneur {{divine_name:DIEU|Yahvé}} : Parce que tu as battu des mains et frappé du pied, et que tu t’es réjoui avec tout le mépris de [ton] âme au sujet de la terre d’Israël,
fr.B: Car le Seigneur {{divine_name:DIEU|Yahvé}} dit ceci : Parce que tu as battu des mains, que tu as tapé du pied et que tu t’es réjoui, le cœur plein de mépris, du malheur de la terre d’Israël,
fr.R: Voici ce que dit le Seigneur {{divine_name:DIEU|Yahvé}} : Vous avez applaudi et tapé du pied. Vous avez été contents que la terre d’Israël soit ruinée, et vous l’avez méprisée de tout votre cœur.

sw.L: Kwa maana Bwana {{divine_name:MUNGU|Yahwe}} asema hivi: Kwa sababu umepiga makofi na kukanyaga kwa mguu, na kufurahi kwa dharau yote ya nafsi [yako] juu ya nchi ya Israeli,
sw.B: Kwa maana hivi ndivyo Bwana {{divine_name:MUNGU|Yahwe}} asemavyo: Kwa kuwa ulipiga makofi na kukanyaga miguu, ukashangilia kwa dharau yote iliyo moyoni mwako juu ya nchi ya Israeli,
sw.R: Hili ndilo Bwana {{divine_name:MUNGU|Yahwe}} analosema: Mlipiga makofi na kukanyaga miguu. Mlifurahi kuona nchi ya Israeli imeharibiwa, mkaidharau kabisa.

es.L: Porque así dice el Señor {{divine_name:DIOS|Yahvé}}: Por cuanto batiste [tus] manos y golpeaste con [tu] pie, y te alegraste con todo el desprecio de [tu] alma sobre la tierra de Israel,
es.B: Porque el Señor {{divine_name:DIOS|Yahvé}} dice esto: Por cuanto aplaudiste y zapateaste y te alegraste con todo el desprecio de tu corazón por la tierra de Israel,
es.R: Esto es lo que dice el Señor {{divine_name:DIOS|Yahvé}}: Aplaudiste y zapateaste. Te alegraste de que la tierra de Israel quedara arruinada, y la despreciaste con todo tu corazón.

ko.L: 참으로 주 {{divine_name:하나님|야훼}}께서 이와 같이 말씀하신다. 네가 손뼉을 치고 발을 구르며, 이스라엘 땅을 두고 [네] 영혼의 온갖 멸시로 기뻐하였으므로,
ko.B: 주 {{divine_name:하나님|야훼}}께서 이렇게 말씀하신다. 네가 이스라엘 땅을 두고 손뼉을 치고 발을 구르며, 마음 가득 멸시하며 고소해하였으므로,
ko.R: 주 {{divine_name:하나님|야훼}}께서 하시는 말씀이다. 너는 손뼉을 치고 발을 굴렀다. 이스라엘 땅이 망한 것을 기뻐하며 그 땅을 마음껏 비웃었다.

decisions.choice: you clapped your hand and stamped your foot: you showed your glee
decisions.reason: Clapping and stamping are strong gestures. Ezekiel himself is told to make them in 6:11 and 21:19, there as a sign of the coming disaster. Here they are the gestures of an enemy delighting in it (compare Lamentations 2:15; Nahum 3:19).

decisions.choice: with all the contempt of your soul: with spiteful scorn
decisions.reason: The word for contempt returns in verse 15 and 36:5. "Soul" (*nefesh*) here is the inner self, so the scorn came from the heart.

decisions.choice: Thus says the Lord GOD (L); The Lord GOD says this (B); This is what the Lord GOD says (R)
decisions.reason: The settled formula. Under the quotation rule for Ezekiel, the LORD's words take no quotation marks; only human speech quoted inside them takes double quotes.

decisions.choice: in your heart
decisions.reason: Balanced says "heart" for *nefesh*, the inner self.

decisions.choice: plural "ninyi" (R) for the people of Ammon
decisions.reason: The Hebrew addresses Ammon in the singular; Readable speaks to the Ammonites as a people in the plural, as the English Readable's "you" may be read.

source.text: לָכֵ֡ן הִנְנִי֩ נָטִ֨יתִי אֶת־יָדִ֜י עָלֶ֗יךָ וּנְתַתִּ֤יךָֽ־לְבַז֙לַגּוֹיִ֔ם וְהִכְרַתִּ֨יךָ֙ מִן־הָ֣עַמִּ֔ים וְהַאֲבַדְתִּ֖יךָ מִן־הָאֲרָצ֑וֹת אַשְׁמִ֣ידְךָ֔ וְיָדַעְתָּ֖ כִּֽי־אֲנִ֥י יְהוָֽה׃ס

records.literal_gloss: therefore, look, I have stretched out my hand against you, and I will give you for plunder to [the] nations, and I will cut you off from the peoples, and I will make you perish from the lands; I will destroy you, and you will know that I [am] Yahweh.

en.L: therefore, look, I have stretched out {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} hand against you, and I will give you to the nations for plunder, and cut you off from among the peoples, and make you perish out of the lands; I will annihilate you, and you will know that I [am] {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}.
en.B: therefore I have stretched out {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} hand against you. I will hand you over as plunder to the nations. I will cut you off from among the peoples and wipe you out from among the lands. I will destroy you. Then you will know that I am {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}.
en.R: So I will use {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} power against you. I will let the nations rob you. I will wipe you out, so that you are no longer a nation and no longer have a land. I will destroy you. Then you will know that I am {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}.

fr.L: c’est pourquoi, voici, j’ai étendu {{deity_pronoun:ma|Ma}} main contre toi, et je te livrerai en pillage aux nations, et je te retrancherai d’entre les peuples, et je te ferai disparaître d’entre les pays ; je t’exterminerai, et tu sauras que je [suis] {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}.
fr.B: c’est pourquoi j’ai étendu {{deity_pronoun:ma|Ma}} main contre toi. Je te livrerai en pillage aux nations. Je te retrancherai d’entre les peuples et je te ferai disparaître d’entre les pays. Je te détruirai. Alors tu sauras que je suis {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}.
fr.R: C’est pourquoi je vais utiliser {{deity_pronoun:ma|Ma}} puissance contre vous. Je laisserai les nations vous piller. Je vous ferai disparaître : vous ne serez plus une nation et vous n’aurez plus de pays. Je vous détruirai. Alors vous saurez que je suis {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}.

sw.L: kwa hiyo, tazama, nimeunyosha mkono {{deity_pronoun:wangu|Wangu}} juu yako, nami nitakutoa kuwa mateka kwa mataifa, na kukukatilia mbali kutoka kati ya mataifa, na kukuangamiza kutoka katika nchi; nitakuharibu kabisa, nawe utajua kwamba {{deity_pronoun:mimi|Mimi}} [ni] {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}.
sw.B: kwa hiyo nimeunyosha mkono {{deity_pronoun:wangu|Wangu}} dhidi yako. Nitakutoa uwe nyara kwa mataifa. Nitakukatilia mbali kutoka kati ya mataifa na kukufutilia mbali kutoka katika nchi. Nitakuangamiza. Ndipo utajua kwamba {{deity_pronoun:mimi|Mimi}} ndimi {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}.
sw.R: Kwa hiyo nitatumia nguvu {{deity_pronoun:yangu|Yangu}} dhidi yenu. Nitayaacha mataifa yawanyang'anye mali yenu. Nitawaangamiza ili msiwe taifa tena wala msiwe na nchi. Nitawaangamiza kabisa. Ndipo mtajua kwamba {{deity_pronoun:mimi|Mimi}} ni {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}.

es.L: por tanto, he aquí, yo he extendido {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} mano contra ti, y te entregaré a las naciones como botín, y te cortaré de entre los pueblos, y te haré perecer de entre las tierras; te destruiré, y sabrás que yo [soy] {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}.
es.B: por eso he extendido {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} mano contra ti. Te entregaré como botín a las naciones. Te eliminaré de entre los pueblos y te borraré de entre las tierras. Te destruiré. Entonces sabrás que yo soy {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}.
es.R: Por eso usaré {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} poder contra ti. Dejaré que las naciones te roben. Te borraré del mapa, para que ya no seas una nación ni tengas una tierra. Te destruiré. Entonces sabrás que yo soy {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}.

ko.L: 그러므로 보라, 내가 내 손을 너에게 뻗었으니, 너를 민족들에게 약탈물로 넘겨주고, 너를 백성들 가운데서 끊어 버리고, 너를 여러 나라 가운데서 사라지게 하겠다. 내가 너를 멸하겠다. 그리고 너는 내가 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}인 줄 알 것이다.
ko.B: 그러므로 내가 내 손을 너에게 뻗었다. 내가 너를 민족들에게 약탈물로 넘겨주겠다. 너를 백성들 가운데서 끊어 버리고, 여러 나라 가운데서 없애 버리겠다. 내가 너를 멸망시키겠다. 그러면 너는 내가 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}인 줄 알게 될 것이다.
ko.R: 그래서 나는 내 힘으로 너를 치겠다. 다른 민족들이 너를 약탈하게 하겠다. 내가 너를 쓸어버려서, 너는 더 이상 한 민족도 아니고 네 땅도 없게 될 것이다. 내가 너를 멸망시키겠다. 그러면 너는 내가 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}인 줄 알게 될 것이다.

decisions.choice: I have stretched out my hand: I have acted against you in power
decisions.reason: The LORD's outstretched hand strikes in judgment (6:14; 14:9, 13; 25:13, 16).

decisions.choice: as plunder
decisions.reason: The written Hebrew has a word not found elsewhere; the reading noted in the margin of the Hebrew text, followed here, is the common word for "plunder", which differs by one letter.

decisions.choice: cut off from the peoples: Ammon would cease to be a nation
decisions.reason: Ammon did disappear as a separate people. The Jewish historian Josephus says that Nebuchadnezzar fought Ammon and Moab some five years after Jerusalem fell (stated from general knowledge), and Arab peoples later held the land.

decisions.choice: I will use my power against you
alternatives: I have stretched out my hand
decisions.reason: Readable says what the outstretched hand means, as in 14:13.

decisions.choice: and you will know that I am the LORD (L); Then you will know (B, R)
decisions.reason: The refrain follows the settled wording for Ezekiel; see the note at 6:7.

decisions.choice: "nitatumia nguvu yangu" (R) for the stretched-out hand
decisions.reason: Readable states the idiom plainly, as the English Readable does; Readable keeps the plural "ninyi" for Ammon as in 25:6.

decisions.choice: sabrás (singular)
decisions.reason: Here the Hebrew 'you will know' is singular, Ammon addressed as one, so Spanish uses 'sabrás' with no plural_you span.

decisions.choice: usaré mi poder contra ti
decisions.reason: R says what the stretched-out hand means, as the English R does; L and B keep 'extender la mano'.

source.text: כֹּ֥ה אָמַ֖ר אֲדֹנָ֣י יְהוִ֑ה יַ֗עַן אֲמֹ֤ר מוֹאָב֙ וְשֵׂעִ֔יר הִנֵּ֥ה כְּכָֽל־הַגּוֹיִ֖ם בֵּ֥ית יְהוּדָֽה׃

records.literal_gloss: Thus says [the] Lord Yahweh: Because Moab and Seir said, Look, like all the nations [is] the house of Judah,

en.L: Thus says the Lord {{divine_name:GOD|Yahweh}}: Because Moab and Seir said, "Look, like all the nations [is] the house of Judah,"
en.B: The Lord {{divine_name:GOD|Yahweh}} says this: Because Moab and Seir said, "See, the people of Judah are just like all the other nations,"
en.R: This is what the Lord {{divine_name:GOD|Yahweh}} says: The people of Moab and Seir said, "Look! The people of Judah are no different from any other nation."

fr.L: Ainsi parle le Seigneur {{divine_name:DIEU|Yahvé}} : Parce que Moab et Séir ont dit : « Voici, comme toutes les nations [est] la maison de Juda »,
fr.B: Le Seigneur {{divine_name:DIEU|Yahvé}} dit ceci : Parce que Moab et Séir ont dit : « Vous voyez, le peuple de Juda est comme toutes les autres nations »,
fr.R: Voici ce que dit le Seigneur {{divine_name:DIEU|Yahvé}} : Les gens de Moab et de Séir ont dit : « Regardez ! Le peuple de Juda n’est pas différent des autres nations. »

sw.L: Bwana {{divine_name:MUNGU|Yahwe}} asema hivi: Kwa sababu Moabu na Seiri walisema, "Tazama, nyumba ya Yuda [ni] kama mataifa yote,"
sw.B: Hivi ndivyo Bwana {{divine_name:MUNGU|Yahwe}} asemavyo: Kwa kuwa Moabu na Seiri walisema, "Angalieni, watu wa Yuda ni kama mataifa mengine yote,"
sw.R: Hili ndilo Bwana {{divine_name:MUNGU|Yahwe}} analosema: Watu wa Moabu na Seiri walisema, "Tazameni! Watu wa Yuda si tofauti na taifa lingine lolote."

es.L: Así dice el Señor {{divine_name:DIOS|Yahvé}}: Por cuanto Moab y Seír dijeron: «He aquí, como todas las naciones [es] la casa de Judá»,
es.B: El Señor {{divine_name:DIOS|Yahvé}} dice esto: Por cuanto Moab y Seír dijeron: «Miren, el pueblo de Judá es igual que todas las demás naciones»,
es.R: Esto es lo que dice el Señor {{divine_name:DIOS|Yahvé}}: La gente de Moab y de Seír dijo: «¡Miren! El pueblo de Judá no es distinto de cualquier otra nación».

ko.L: 주 {{divine_name:하나님|야훼}}께서 이와 같이 말씀하신다. 모압과 세일이 "보라, 유다 집은 모든 민족과 같다" 하고 말하였으므로,
ko.B: 주 {{divine_name:하나님|야훼}}께서 이렇게 말씀하신다. 모압과 세일이 "보아라, 유다 백성도 다른 모든 민족과 다를 것이 없다" 하고 말하였으므로,
ko.R: 주 {{divine_name:하나님|야훼}}께서 하시는 말씀이다. 모압과 세일 사람들이 "봐라! 유다 백성도 다른 나라와 하나도 다를 게 없다" 하고 말했다.

decisions.choice: Moab and Seir: the peoples east and south of the Dead Sea
decisions.reason: Moab lay east of the Dead Sea; like Ammon it traced its descent to Lot (Genesis 19:37). Seir is the hill country of Edom (Genesis 36:8), so "Seir" here looks ahead to the oracle on Edom in verses 12-14 and to chapter 35.

decisions.choice: and Seir
decisions.reason: The Greek translation has only "Moab" here (stated from general knowledge). The Hebrew is kept.

decisions.choice: the house of Judah is like all the nations: Judah's God is no different from other gods
decisions.reason: Israel was to be set apart from the nations (Numbers 23:9; Deuteronomy 7:6). Moab says that Judah's fall proves the opposite: its God could not save it any more than the gods of other peoples. The scorn falls on the LORD himself.

decisions.choice: double quotation marks for Moab's words
decisions.reason: Human speech quoted inside the LORD's oracle takes double quotes, under the quotation rule for Ezekiel.

decisions.choice: Seír
decisions.reason: The name is spelled as published in Spanish Chronicles (el monte Seír), and Moab's words, human speech inside the oracle, take « ».

source.text: לָכֵן֩ הִנְנִ֨י פֹתֵ֜חַ אֶת־כֶּ֤תֶף מוֹאָב֙ מֵהֶ֣עָרִ֔ים מֵֽעָרָ֖יו מִקָּצֵ֑הוּ צְבִ֗י אֶ֚רֶץ בֵּ֣ית הַיְשִׁימֹ֔ת בַּ֥עַל מְע֖וֹן וְקִרְיָתָֽיְמָה׃

records.literal_gloss: therefore, look, I [am] about to open the slope of Moab from the cities, from its cities from its border, [the] beauty of [the] land, Beth-jeshimoth, Baal-meon, and Kiriathaim,

en.L: therefore, look, I am laying open the flank of Moab, from the cities, from its cities on its frontier, the glory of the land, Beth-jeshimoth, Baal-meon and Kiriathaim,
en.B: therefore I am going to lay bare the flank of Moab, stripping it of its cities, the cities on its frontier, the pride of the land: Beth-jeshimoth, Baal-meon and Kiriathaim.
en.R: So I will leave the side of Moab open to attack. I will take away the towns on its border, the towns its people are proud of: Beth-jeshimoth, Baal-meon and Kiriathaim.

fr.L: c’est pourquoi, voici, j’ouvre le flanc de Moab, du côté des villes, de ses villes jusqu’à sa frontière, la splendeur du pays, Beth-Yeshimoth, Baal-Méôn et Qiryathaïm,
fr.B: c’est pourquoi je vais mettre à nu le flanc de Moab et lui enlever ses villes, les villes de sa frontière, la fierté du pays : Beth-Yeshimoth, Baal-Méôn et Qiryathaïm.
fr.R: C’est pourquoi je vais laisser le flanc de Moab ouvert aux attaques. Je lui enlèverai les villes de sa frontière, les villes dont ses habitants sont fiers : Beth-Yeshimoth, Baal-Méôn et Qiryathaïm.

sw.L: kwa hiyo, tazama, ninaufungua ubavu wa Moabu, kuanzia miji, miji yake iliyo mpakani mwake, fahari ya nchi, Beth-yeshimothi, Baal-meoni na Kiriathaimu,
sw.B: kwa hiyo nitauacha wazi ubavu wa Moabu, nikiinyang'anya miji yake, miji iliyo mpakani mwake, fahari ya nchi: Beth-yeshimothi, Baal-meoni na Kiriathaimu.
sw.R: Kwa hiyo nitauacha upande wa Moabu wazi ili ushambuliwe. Nitaiondoa miji iliyo mpakani mwake, miji ambayo watu wake wanaionea fahari: Beth-yeshimothi, Baal-meoni na Kiriathaimu.

es.L: por tanto, he aquí, yo abro el flanco de Moab, desde las ciudades, desde sus ciudades de su frontera, la gloria de la tierra: Bet-jesimot, Baal-meón y Quiriataim,
es.B: por eso voy a dejar al descubierto el flanco de Moab y despojarlo de sus ciudades, de las ciudades de su frontera, el orgullo de la tierra: Bet-jesimot, Baal-meón y Quiriataim.
es.R: Por eso dejaré abierto a los ataques el costado de Moab. Le quitaré las ciudades de su frontera, las ciudades de las que su gente está orgullosa: Bet-jesimot, Baal-meón y Quiriataim.

ko.L: 그러므로 보라, 내가 모압의 옆구리를 열겠다. 성읍들에서부터, 그 변경에 있는 그 성읍들에서부터, 그 땅의 영광인 벧여시못과 바알므온과 기랴다임을 [열어],
ko.B: 그러므로 내가 모압의 옆구리를 드러내어, 그 성읍들, 곧 그 땅의 자랑인 변경의 성읍들 벧여시못과 바알므온과 기랴다임을 빼앗겠다.
ko.R: 그래서 나는 모압의 옆구리를 적의 공격에 열어 두겠다. 모압 백성이 자랑으로 여기는 국경 성읍들, 곧 벧여시못과 바알므온과 기랴다임을 빼앗겠다.

decisions.choice: open the flank of Moab: lay open its defenses
decisions.reason: The word means a shoulder or slope. Moab's high plateau rises steeply from the Jordan valley and the Dead Sea, and its towns on the edge guarded it. When they fall, the land lies open to invaders.

decisions.choice: from the cities, from its cities on its frontier: the frontier towns, or every last town
alternatives: its cities, every one of them
decisions.reason: The Hebrew piles up phrases. It may mean the towns on Moab's border, which the names that follow are, or "its cities, from one end to the other".

decisions.choice: Beth-jeshimoth, Baal-meon and Kiriathaim: towns on the plateau north of the Arnon
decisions.reason: These towns had been given to Reuben (Numbers 32:37-38; Joshua 13:17-20), but Moab had taken them back. Moab was proud of them as "the glory of the land". Baal-meon and Kiriathaim are named as Moabite towns on the Moabite Stone, the inscription of King Mesha (stated from general knowledge; compare 2 Kings 3:4).

decisions.choice: Beth-jeshimoth, Baal-meon, Kiriathaim
decisions.reason: The names are spelled as in Joshua 13:20, Numbers 32:38 and Jeremiah 48:1. Balanced closes the sentence here and goes on in verse 10; Readable says "towns" for the smaller cities of Moab.

decisions.choice: "Beth-Yeshimoth, Baal-Méôn et Qiryathaïm"
decisions.reason: The forms of published Joshua 12:3, 1 Chronicles 5:8 and Jeremiah 48:23.

decisions.choice: "Beth-yeshimothi, Baal-meoni, Kiriathaimu"
decisions.reason: The forms of the Swahili Joshua 13:20, Numbers 32:38 and Jeremiah 48:1.

decisions.choice: Bet-jesimot, Baal-meón, Quiriataim
decisions.reason: The towns keep their published Spanish forms (Numbers 33:49; 32:38; Joshua 13:19).

source.text: לִבְנֵי־קֶ֨דֶם֙ עַל־בְּנֵ֣י עַמּ֔וֹן וּנְתַתִּ֖יהָ לְמֽוֹרָשָׁ֑ה לְמַ֛עַן לֹֽא־תִזָּכֵ֥ר בְּנֵֽי־עַמּ֖וֹן בַּגּוֹיִֽם׃

records.literal_gloss: to [the] sons of [the] east, against [the] sons of Ammon, and I will give it as a possession, so that not will be remembered [the] sons of Ammon among [the] nations.

en.L: to the {{gender:people|sons}} of the east, along with the {{gender:children|sons}} of Ammon; and I will give it as a possession, so that the {{gender:children|sons}} of Ammon will not be remembered among the nations.
en.B: I will give it to the people of the east, along with the Ammonites, as their possession, so that the Ammonites will be remembered no more among the nations.
en.R: I will give Moab to the desert tribes from the east, as I will give them the land of Ammon. Then no one among the nations will remember the Ammonites anymore.

fr.L: aux {{gender:enfants|fils}} de l’Orient, avec les {{gender:enfants|fils}} d’Ammon ; et je la donnerai en possession, afin qu’on ne se souvienne plus des {{gender:enfants|fils}} d’Ammon parmi les nations.
fr.B: Je le donnerai en possession aux peuples de l’Orient, avec le pays des Ammonites, afin qu’on ne se souvienne plus des Ammonites parmi les nations.
fr.R: Je donnerai Moab aux tribus du désert, comme je leur donnerai le pays d’Ammon. Alors, parmi les nations, plus personne ne se souviendra des Ammonites.

sw.L: kwa wana wa mashariki, pamoja na wana wa Amoni; nami nitaitoa iwe milki, ili wana wa Amoni wasikumbukwe tena kati ya mataifa.
sw.B: Nitaitoa kwa watu wa mashariki pamoja na Waamoni iwe milki yao, ili Waamoni wasikumbukwe tena kati ya mataifa.
sw.R: Nitaitoa Moabu kwa makabila ya jangwani kutoka mashariki, kama nitakavyowapa nchi ya Amoni. Ndipo hakuna mtu kati ya mataifa atakayewakumbuka Waamoni tena.

es.L: a los hijos del oriente, junto con los hijos de Amón; y la daré como posesión, para que no haya memoria de los hijos de Amón entre las naciones.
es.B: Se la daré como posesión a los pueblos del oriente, junto con los amonitas, para que nunca más se recuerde a los amonitas entre las naciones.
es.R: Daré Moab a las tribus del desierto del oriente, así como les daré la tierra de Amón. Entonces nadie entre las naciones volverá a acordarse de los amonitas.

ko.L: 동방 사람들에게 암몬 {{gender:자손|아들들}}과 함께 [넘겨주겠다]. 내가 그것을 소유로 주어, 암몬 {{gender:자손|아들들}}이 민족들 가운데서 기억되지 않게 하겠다.
ko.B: 내가 그 땅을 암몬 땅과 함께 동방 사람들에게 넘겨주어 그들의 소유가 되게 하겠다. 그리하여 암몬 사람들이 민족들 가운데서 다시는 기억되지 않게 하겠다.
ko.R: 내가 암몬 땅을 동쪽 사막 부족들에게 주는 것처럼 모압도 그들에게 주겠다. 그러면 민족들 가운데서 아무도 암몬 사람들을 더 이상 기억하지 않을 것이다.

decisions.choice: along with the sons of Ammon: Moab will go the same way as Ammon
decisions.reason: The preposition can mean "against" or "in addition to". Ammon was already given to the people of the east (verse 4); Moab is added to it.

decisions.choice: will not be remembered among the nations: will cease to exist as a people
decisions.reason: To be forgotten is to be gone, with no name left (21:37; Psalm 83:5).

decisions.choice: I will give Moab ... as I will give them the land of Ammon
decisions.reason: Readable names Moab, since "it" refers back to the flank of Moab in verse 9, and says plainly that Ammon shares its fate.

source.text: וּבְמוֹאָ֖ב אֶעֱשֶׂ֣ה שְׁפָטִ֑ים וְיָדְע֖וּ כִּֽי־אֲנִ֥י יְהוָֽה׃ס

records.literal_gloss: And on Moab I will execute judgments, and they will know that I [am] Yahweh.

en.L: And on Moab I will execute judgments, and they will know that I [am] {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}.
en.B: I will carry out judgments on Moab. Then they will know that I am {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}.
en.R: I will punish Moab. Then they will know that I am {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}.

fr.L: Et sur Moab j’exécuterai des jugements, et ils sauront que je [suis] {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}.
fr.B: J’exécuterai mes jugements sur Moab. Alors ils sauront que je suis {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}.
fr.R: Je punirai Moab. Alors ses habitants sauront que je suis {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}.

sw.L: Nami nitatekeleza hukumu juu ya Moabu, nao watajua kwamba {{deity_pronoun:mimi|Mimi}} [ni] {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}.
sw.B: Nitatekeleza hukumu juu ya Moabu. Ndipo watajua kwamba {{deity_pronoun:mimi|Mimi}} ndimi {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}.
sw.R: Nitaiadhibu Moabu. Ndipo watajua kwamba {{deity_pronoun:mimi|Mimi}} ni {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}.

es.L: Y en Moab ejecutaré juicios, y sabrán que yo [soy] {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}.
es.B: Ejecutaré juicios sobre Moab. Entonces sabrán que yo soy {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}.
es.R: Castigaré a Moab. Entonces sabrán que yo soy {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}.

ko.L: 그리고 내가 모압에게 심판을 행하겠다. 그리고 그들은 내가 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}인 줄 알 것이다.
ko.B: 내가 모압에게 심판을 내리겠다. 그러면 그들은 내가 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}인 줄 알게 될 것이다.
ko.R: 내가 모압을 벌하겠다. 그러면 그들은 내가 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}인 줄 알게 될 것이다.

decisions.choice: judgments: punishments carried out as sentences
decisions.reason: The word means acts of judgment, the sentence put into effect (5:10, 15; 11:9; 16:41).

decisions.choice: I will punish
decisions.reason: Readable says what executing judgments means.

decisions.choice: and they will know that I am the LORD (L); Then they will know (B, R)
decisions.reason: The refrain follows the settled wording for Ezekiel; see the note at 6:7.

source.text: כֹּ֤ה אָמַר֙ אֲדֹנָ֣י יְהוִ֔ה יַ֣עַן עֲשׂ֥וֹת אֱד֛וֹם בִּנְקֹ֥ם נָקָ֖ם לְבֵ֣ית יְהוּדָ֑ה וַיֶּאְשְׁמ֥וּ אָשׁ֖וֹם וְנִקְּמ֥וּ בָהֶֽם׃

records.literal_gloss: Thus says [the] Lord Yahweh: Because Edom acted in taking vengeance on the house of Judah, and they have become guilty, greatly guilty, and have avenged themselves on them,

en.L: Thus says the Lord {{divine_name:GOD|Yahweh}}: Because Edom acted by taking vengeance on the house of Judah, and they have become greatly guilty and avenged themselves on them,
en.B: The Lord {{divine_name:GOD|Yahweh}} says this: Because Edom took revenge on the people of Judah and became deeply guilty by avenging itself on them,
en.R: This is what the Lord {{divine_name:GOD|Yahweh}} says: The people of Edom took revenge on the people of Judah. They did great wrong when they paid Judah back.

fr.L: Ainsi parle le Seigneur {{divine_name:DIEU|Yahvé}} : Parce qu’Édom a agi en se vengeant de la maison de Juda, et qu’ils se sont rendus grandement coupables et se sont vengés d’eux,
fr.B: Le Seigneur {{divine_name:DIEU|Yahvé}} dit ceci : Parce qu’Édom s’est vengé du peuple de Juda et s’est rendu gravement coupable en se vengeant de lui,
fr.R: Voici ce que dit le Seigneur {{divine_name:DIEU|Yahvé}} : Les gens d’Édom se sont vengés du peuple de Juda. Ils ont commis une grande faute en lui rendant le mal pour le mal.

sw.L: Bwana {{divine_name:MUNGU|Yahwe}} asema hivi: Kwa sababu Edomu ametenda kwa kulipiza kisasi juu ya nyumba ya Yuda, nao wamekuwa na hatia kubwa kwa kujilipizia kisasi juu yao,
sw.B: Hivi ndivyo Bwana {{divine_name:MUNGU|Yahwe}} asemavyo: Kwa kuwa Edomu alilipiza kisasi juu ya watu wa Yuda, akawa na hatia kubwa kwa kujilipizia kisasi juu yao,
sw.R: Hili ndilo Bwana {{divine_name:MUNGU|Yahwe}} analosema: Watu wa Edomu walilipiza kisasi juu ya watu wa Yuda. Walifanya kosa kubwa walipowalipiza.

es.L: Así dice el Señor {{divine_name:DIOS|Yahvé}}: Por cuanto Edom obró tomando venganza de la casa de Judá, y se hicieron muy culpables y se vengaron de ellos,
es.B: El Señor {{divine_name:DIOS|Yahvé}} dice esto: Por cuanto Edom se vengó del pueblo de Judá y se hizo muy culpable al vengarse de ellos,
es.R: Esto es lo que dice el Señor {{divine_name:DIOS|Yahvé}}: La gente de Edom se vengó del pueblo de Judá. Hicieron un gran mal cuando le hicieron pagar a Judá.

ko.L: 주 {{divine_name:하나님|야훼}}께서 이와 같이 말씀하신다. 에돔이 유다 집에 원수를 갚는 일을 행하였고, 그들이 크게 죄를 지어 그들에게 앙갚음하였으므로,
ko.B: 주 {{divine_name:하나님|야훼}}께서 이렇게 말씀하신다. 에돔이 유다 백성에게 원수를 갚고, 그렇게 앙갚음하여 큰 죄를 지었으므로,
ko.R: 주 {{divine_name:하나님|야훼}}께서 하시는 말씀이다. 에돔 사람들이 유다 백성에게 원수를 갚았다. 그들은 유다에게 앙갚음하면서 큰 잘못을 저질렀다.

decisions.choice: Edom: the people descended from Esau, south of the Dead Sea
decisions.reason: Edom's people came from Esau, Jacob's brother (Genesis 36:1, 8). When Jerusalem fell, Edom joined in its ruin, and the Bible remembers it bitterly (Obadiah 10-14; Psalm 137:7; Lamentations 4:21-22). Chapter 35 returns to Edom at length.

decisions.choice: taking vengeance: paying back an old grievance
decisions.reason: The word for vengeance comes five times in verses 12-17. Edom and the Philistines took vengeance for themselves; the LORD will take his own (verses 14 and 17).

decisions.choice: they have become greatly guilty: the verb is doubled
decisions.reason: The Hebrew repeats the verb for emphasis. Edom is first spoken of as one nation, then as "they", its people.

decisions.choice: Thus says the Lord GOD (L); The Lord GOD says this (B); This is what the Lord GOD says (R)
decisions.reason: The settled formula. Under the quotation rule for Ezekiel, the LORD's words take no quotation marks; only human speech quoted inside them takes double quotes.

source.text: לָכֵ֗ן כֹּ֤ה אָמַר֙ אֲדֹנָ֣י יְהוִ֔ה וְנָטִ֤תִי יָדִי֙ עַל־אֱד֔וֹם וְהִכְרַתִּ֥י מִמֶּ֖נָּה אָדָ֣ם וּבְהֵמָ֑ה וּנְתַתִּ֤יהָ חָרְבָּה֙ מִתֵּימָ֔ן וּדְדָ֖נֶה בַּחֶ֥רֶב יִפֹּֽלוּ׃

records.literal_gloss: therefore thus says [the] Lord Yahweh: And I will stretch out my hand against Edom and cut off from it human and beast, and I will make it a desolation; from Teman even to Dedan by the sword they will fall.

en.L: therefore thus says the Lord {{divine_name:GOD|Yahweh}}: I will stretch out {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} hand against Edom and will cut off from it human and beast, and I will make it a desolation; from Teman even to Dedan they will fall by the sword.
en.B: therefore the Lord {{divine_name:GOD|Yahweh}} says this: I will stretch out {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} hand against Edom and wipe out both its people and its animals. I will make it a wasteland; from Teman to Dedan they will fall by the sword.
en.R: So this is what the Lord {{divine_name:GOD|Yahweh}} says: I will use {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} power against Edom. I will kill its people and its animals. I will turn it into a wasteland. From Teman to Dedan, its people will be killed in war.

fr.L: c’est pourquoi ainsi parle le Seigneur {{divine_name:DIEU|Yahvé}} : J’étendrai {{deity_pronoun:ma|Ma}} main contre Édom, et j’en retrancherai homme et bête, et j’en ferai une ruine ; de Téman jusqu’à Dedan ils tomberont par l’épée.
fr.B: c’est pourquoi le Seigneur {{divine_name:DIEU|Yahvé}} dit ceci : J’étendrai {{deity_pronoun:ma|Ma}} main contre Édom et j’en ferai disparaître les gens comme les bêtes. J’en ferai un désert ; de Téman jusqu’à Dedan, ils tomberont par l’épée.
fr.R: Alors voici ce que dit le Seigneur {{divine_name:DIEU|Yahvé}} : Je vais utiliser {{deity_pronoun:ma|Ma}} puissance contre Édom. J’y tuerai les gens et les animaux. Je le transformerai en désert. De Téman à Dedan, ses habitants seront tués à la guerre.

sw.L: kwa hiyo Bwana {{divine_name:MUNGU|Yahwe}} asema hivi: Nami nitaunyosha mkono {{deity_pronoun:wangu|Wangu}} juu ya Edomu, na kukatilia mbali kutoka kwake binadamu na mnyama, nami nitaifanya kuwa ukiwa; kutoka Temani hata Dedani wataanguka kwa upanga.
sw.B: kwa hiyo hivi ndivyo Bwana {{divine_name:MUNGU|Yahwe}} asemavyo: Nitaunyosha mkono {{deity_pronoun:wangu|Wangu}} dhidi ya Edomu na kuwaangamiza watu wake na wanyama wake pia. Nitaifanya kuwa nchi ya ukiwa; kutoka Temani hadi Dedani wataanguka kwa upanga.
sw.R: Kwa hiyo hili ndilo Bwana {{divine_name:MUNGU|Yahwe}} analosema: Nitatumia nguvu {{deity_pronoun:yangu|Yangu}} dhidi ya Edomu. Nitawaua watu wake na wanyama wake. Nitaigeuza kuwa nyika. Kutoka Temani hadi Dedani watu wake watauawa vitani.

es.L: por tanto, así dice el Señor {{divine_name:DIOS|Yahvé}}: Extenderé {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} mano contra Edom y cortaré de ella hombres y bestias, y la convertiré en desolación; desde Temán hasta Dedán caerán a espada.
es.B: por eso el Señor {{divine_name:DIOS|Yahvé}} dice esto: Extenderé {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} mano contra Edom y eliminaré de ella tanto a la gente como a los animales. La convertiré en un desierto; desde Temán hasta Dedán caerán a espada.
es.R: Así que esto es lo que dice el Señor {{divine_name:DIOS|Yahvé}}: Usaré {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} poder contra Edom. Mataré a su gente y a sus animales. La convertiré en un desierto. Desde Temán hasta Dedán, su gente morirá en la guerra.

ko.L: 그러므로 주 {{divine_name:하나님|야훼}}께서 이와 같이 말씀하신다. 내가 내 손을 에돔 위에 뻗어, 그 땅에서 사람과 짐승을 끊어 버리고, 그 땅을 황무지로 만들겠다. 데만에서부터 드단까지 그들이 칼에 쓰러질 것이다.
ko.B: 그러므로 주 {{divine_name:하나님|야훼}}께서 이렇게 말씀하신다. 내가 에돔을 향해 내 손을 뻗어 그 땅의 사람과 짐승을 모두 없애 버리고, 그 땅을 황무지로 만들겠다. 데만에서 드단까지 그들이 칼에 쓰러질 것이다.
ko.R: 그래서 주 {{divine_name:하나님|야훼}}께서 하시는 말씀이다. 나는 내 힘으로 에돔을 치겠다. 그 땅의 사람과 짐승을 죽이겠다. 그 땅을 황무지로 만들겠다. 데만에서 드단까지 에돔 사람들이 전쟁에서 죽을 것이다.

decisions.choice: from Teman to Dedan: from one end of Edom to the other
decisions.reason: Teman was a chief region of Edom (Jeremiah 49:7; Amos 1:12). Dedan was an Arabian trading people to the southeast whose lands bordered Edom (Jeremiah 49:8). The pair marks the whole country.

decisions.choice: human and beast: every living thing
decisions.reason: The pair stands for all life in a land, as in 14:13 and 14:17.

decisions.choice: human and beast (L); both people and animals (B); its people and its animals (R)
decisions.reason: The wording follows 14:13 and 14:17. Readable says "killed in war" for "fall by the sword", as in 17:21.

decisions.choice: "homme et bête" (L) without a gender span
decisions.reason: A fixed pair meaning every living thing, as published Jeremiah's "homme et bête"; B and R say "les gens".

decisions.choice: hombres y bestias
decisions.reason: 'Adam u-vehemah' is worded as Spanish usually pairs them at L, the plain 'hombres' covering people of both sexes; B and R say 'la gente' and 'los animales'.

source.text: וְנָתַתִּ֨י אֶת־נִקְמָתִ֜י בֶּאֱד֗וֹם בְּיַד֙ עַמִּ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל וְעָשׂ֣וּ בֶאֱד֔וֹם כְּאַפִּ֖י וְכַחֲמָתִ֑י וְיָֽדְעוּ֙ אֶת־נִקְמָתִ֔י נְאֻ֖ם אֲדֹנָ֥י יְהוִֽה׃פ

records.literal_gloss: And I will put my vengeance on Edom by [the] hand of my people Israel, and they will do in Edom according to my anger and according to my wrath, and they will know my vengeance, declaration of [the] Lord Yahweh.

en.L: And I will lay {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} vengeance upon Edom through the hand of {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} people Israel, and they will act in Edom according to {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} anger and {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} wrath; and they will know {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} vengeance, declares the Lord {{divine_name:GOD|Yahweh}}.
en.B: I will take {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} vengeance on Edom through {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} people Israel. They will deal with Edom as {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} anger and {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} wrath demand, and they will know what {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} vengeance is, declares the Lord {{divine_name:GOD|Yahweh}}.
en.R: I will use {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} people Israel to pay Edom back. They will treat Edom as {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} great anger demands. Then the people of Edom will know what it is like when I pay them back, says the Lord {{divine_name:GOD|Yahweh}}.

fr.L: Et je mettrai {{deity_pronoun:ma|Ma}} vengeance sur Édom par la main de {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} peuple Israël, et ils agiront en Édom selon {{deity_pronoun:ma|Ma}} colère et selon {{deity_pronoun:ma|Ma}} fureur ; et ils connaîtront {{deity_pronoun:ma|Ma}} vengeance, déclare le Seigneur {{divine_name:DIEU|Yahvé}}.
fr.B: Je tirerai vengeance d’Édom par {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} peuple Israël. Il traitera Édom comme l’exigent {{deity_pronoun:ma|Ma}} colère et {{deity_pronoun:ma|Ma}} fureur, et ils sauront ce qu’est {{deity_pronoun:ma|Ma}} vengeance, déclare le Seigneur {{divine_name:DIEU|Yahvé}}.
fr.R: Je me servirai de {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} peuple Israël pour faire payer Édom. Il traitera Édom comme {{deity_pronoun:ma|Ma}} grande colère l’exige. Alors les gens d’Édom sauront ce que c’est quand je leur fais payer ce qu’ils ont fait, dit le Seigneur {{divine_name:DIEU|Yahvé}}.

sw.L: Nami nitaweka kisasi {{deity_pronoun:wangu|Wangu}} juu ya Edomu kwa mkono wa watu {{deity_pronoun:wangu|Wangu}} Israeli, nao watatenda katika Edomu kulingana na hasira {{deity_pronoun:wangu|Wangu}} na kulingana na ghadhabu {{deity_pronoun:yangu|Yangu}}; nao watakijua kisasi {{deity_pronoun:wangu|Wangu}}, asema Bwana {{divine_name:MUNGU|Yahwe}}.
sw.B: Nitalipiza kisasi {{deity_pronoun:wangu|Wangu}} juu ya Edomu kupitia watu {{deity_pronoun:wangu|Wangu}} Israeli. Watamtendea Edomu kama hasira {{deity_pronoun:wangu|Wangu}} na ghadhabu {{deity_pronoun:yangu|Yangu}} zinavyotaka, nao watajua kisasi {{deity_pronoun:wangu|Wangu}} ni nini, asema Bwana {{divine_name:MUNGU|Yahwe}}.
sw.R: Nitawatumia watu {{deity_pronoun:wangu|Wangu}} Israeli kumlipiza Edomu. Watamtendea Edomu kama hasira {{deity_pronoun:yangu|Yangu}} kali inavyotaka. Ndipo watu wa Edomu watajua jinsi ilivyo ninapowalipiza, anasema Bwana {{divine_name:MUNGU|Yahwe}}.

es.L: Y pondré {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} venganza sobre Edom por mano de {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} pueblo Israel, y harán en Edom conforme a {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} ira y conforme a {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} furor; y conocerán {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} venganza, declara el Señor {{divine_name:DIOS|Yahvé}}.
es.B: Me vengaré de Edom por medio de {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} pueblo Israel. Tratarán a Edom como lo exigen {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} ira y {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} furor, y sabrán lo que es {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} venganza, afirma el Señor {{divine_name:DIOS|Yahvé}}.
es.R: Usaré a {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} pueblo Israel para hacer pagar a Edom. Tratarán a Edom como lo exige {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} gran enojo. Entonces la gente de Edom sabrá lo que es cuando yo le hago pagar, dice el Señor {{divine_name:DIOS|Yahvé}}.

ko.L: 그리고 내가 내 백성 이스라엘의 손으로 에돔에게 내 원수 갚음을 내리겠다. 그들이 내 분노와 내 진노대로 에돔에게 행할 것이다. 그리고 그들이 내 원수 갚음을 알 것이다. 주 {{divine_name:하나님|야훼}}의 선언이다.
ko.B: 내가 내 백성 이스라엘을 통해 에돔에게 원수를 갚겠다. 그들이 내 분노와 진노가 요구하는 대로 에돔을 다룰 것이다. 그러면 에돔은 내 원수 갚음이 어떤 것인지 알게 될 것이다. 주 {{divine_name:하나님|야훼}}의 말이다.
ko.R: 나는 내 백성 이스라엘을 시켜 에돔에게 갚아 주겠다. 이스라엘이 나의 큰 분노대로 에돔을 다룰 것이다. 그러면 에돔 사람들은 내가 갚아 줄 때 어떤 일이 일어나는지 알게 될 것이다. 주 {{divine_name:하나님|야훼}}의 말이다.

decisions.choice: my vengeance: just punishment by the rightful judge
decisions.reason: Edom took vengeance for itself (verse 12). Vengeance belongs to the LORD (Deuteronomy 32:35), and in his hands it is not spite but the putting right of wrong by the judge of all.

decisions.choice: by the hand of my people Israel: Israel as the LORD's instrument
decisions.reason: The text names no time. In the second century BC the Jewish ruler John Hyrcanus conquered the Edomites, by then called Idumeans (stated from general knowledge).

decisions.choice: declares the Lord GOD (L, B); says the Lord GOD (R)
decisions.reason: The settled wording for *ne'um Adonai YHWH* in Ezekiel. Readable says "pay back" for vengeance, which is what the word means here.

decisions.choice: *ne'um Adonai YHWH* "déclare le Seigneur DIEU" (L, B), "dit le Seigneur DIEU" (R), for chapters 25-33
decisions.reason: The settled French wording of the formula in Isaiah, Jeremiah and Ezekiel.

decisions.choice: "asema Bwana MUNGU" (L, B); "anasema Bwana MUNGU" (R); "ghadhabu" (L, B), "hasira" (R) for chemah
decisions.reason: The term sheet's forms for ne'um Adonai YHWH and for wrath; here "hasira" at L and B renders the paired word 'af (anger).

decisions.choice: declara (L); afirma (B); dice (R) el Señor DIOS
decisions.reason: Ne'um Adonai YHWH keeps the wording of Spanish Isaiah and of the earlier chapters of Ezekiel at each level, always after a comma.

decisions.choice: ira ... furor
decisions.reason: 'Af' is 'ira' and 'chemah' 'furor', Ezekiel's word for wrath through the book; R joins them as 'gran enojo', as the English R does.

decisions.choice: "주 {{divine_name:하나님|야훼}}의 선언이다" (L); "주 {{divine_name:하나님|야훼}}의 말이다" (B, R) for "declares the Lord GOD", standing as its own sentence
decisions.reason: The term sheet's wording (uncertain): the Isaiah form "…가 말한다" cannot follow {{divine_name:하나님|야훼}}, whose two forms need different particles, so B and R say "…의 말이다", as Ezekiel 13-21 do.

decisions.choice: "원수 갚음", "원수를 갚다" (L, B) for God's vengeance (neqamah); "갚아 주다" (R)
decisions.reason: God's vengeance is just repayment, not spite (see the meaning decision), so Korean uses the plain "pay back" wording rather than "복수", which sounds personal; "앙갚음" is kept for the nations' revenge in 25:12 and 25:15.

source.text: כֹּ֤ה אָמַר֙ אֲדֹנָ֣י יְהוִ֔ה יַ֛עַן עֲשׂ֥וֹת פְּלִשְׁתִּ֖ים בִּנְקָמָ֑ה וַיִּנָּקְמ֤וּ נָקָם֙ בִּשְׁאָ֣ט בְּנֶ֔פֶשׁ לְמַשְׁחִ֖ית אֵיבַ֥ת עוֹלָֽם׃

records.literal_gloss: Thus says [the] Lord Yahweh: Because [the] Philistines acted in vengeance, and avenged themselves [with] vengeance with contempt in [the] soul, to destroy, [with] enmity of antiquity,

en.L: Thus says the Lord {{divine_name:GOD|Yahweh}}: Because the Philistines acted in vengeance and took vengeance with contempt of soul, to destroy, [with] age-old hostility,
en.B: The Lord {{divine_name:GOD|Yahweh}} says this: Because the Philistines acted in revenge, taking vengeance with scorn in their hearts and seeking to destroy Judah out of their age-old hatred,
en.R: This is what the Lord {{divine_name:GOD|Yahweh}} says: The Philistines took revenge. They were full of scorn, and they tried to destroy Judah, because they have always hated Judah.

fr.L: Ainsi parle le Seigneur {{divine_name:DIEU|Yahvé}} : Parce que les Philistins ont agi par vengeance, et qu’ils se sont vengés avec le mépris de l’âme, pour détruire, [avec] une hostilité ancienne,
fr.B: Le Seigneur {{divine_name:DIEU|Yahvé}} dit ceci : Parce que les Philistins ont agi par vengeance, qu’ils se sont vengés avec mépris et ont cherché à détruire Juda par une haine qui remonte loin,
fr.R: Voici ce que dit le Seigneur {{divine_name:DIEU|Yahvé}} : Les Philistins se sont vengés. Ils étaient pleins de mépris, et ils ont essayé de détruire Juda, parce qu’ils l’ont toujours haï.

sw.L: Bwana {{divine_name:MUNGU|Yahwe}} asema hivi: Kwa sababu Wafilisti wametenda kwa kisasi, na kulipiza kisasi kwa dharau ya nafsi, ili kuangamiza, [kwa] uadui wa kale,
sw.B: Hivi ndivyo Bwana {{divine_name:MUNGU|Yahwe}} asemavyo: Kwa kuwa Wafilisti walitenda kwa kulipiza kisasi, wakajilipizia kisasi kwa dharau mioyoni mwao, wakitaka kuiangamiza Yuda kwa sababu ya chuki yao ya tangu zamani,
sw.R: Hili ndilo Bwana {{divine_name:MUNGU|Yahwe}} analosema: Wafilisti walilipiza kisasi. Walijaa dharau, wakajaribu kuiangamiza Yuda, kwa sababu wameichukia Yuda tangu zamani.

es.L: Así dice el Señor {{divine_name:DIOS|Yahvé}}: Por cuanto los filisteos obraron con venganza, y se vengaron con desprecio de alma, para destruir, [con] enemistad antigua,
es.B: El Señor {{divine_name:DIOS|Yahvé}} dice esto: Por cuanto los filisteos actuaron por venganza, vengándose con desprecio en el corazón y tratando de destruir a Judá por su antiguo odio,
es.R: Esto es lo que dice el Señor {{divine_name:DIOS|Yahvé}}: Los filisteos se vengaron. Estaban llenos de desprecio, y trataron de destruir a Judá porque siempre lo han odiado.

ko.L: 주 {{divine_name:하나님|야훼}}께서 이와 같이 말씀하신다. 블레셋 사람들이 원수 갚는 일을 행하여, 영혼의 멸시를 품고 앙갚음하여, 오랜 적개심으로 멸망시키려 하였으므로,
ko.B: 주 {{divine_name:하나님|야훼}}께서 이렇게 말씀하신다. 블레셋 사람들이 앙갚음을 하며, 마음에 멸시를 품고 원수를 갚아, 오래된 증오로 유다를 멸망시키려 하였으므로,
ko.R: 주 {{divine_name:하나님|야훼}}께서 하시는 말씀이다. 블레셋 사람들이 앙갚음을 했다. 그들은 유다를 몹시 업신여겼고, 유다를 멸망시키려고 했다. 그들은 늘 유다를 미워해 왔기 때문이다.

decisions.choice: the Philistines: Israel's old enemies on the southern coast
decisions.reason: The Philistines held the coastal plain, with cities such as Gaza, Ashkelon and Ashdod. They fought Israel from the days of the judges and of Saul (Judges 13-16; 1 Samuel 4; 31). Their hostility was "age-old".

decisions.choice: to destroy, with age-old hostility: an old hatred that sought Judah's ruin
decisions.reason: The words describe their purpose: to bring Judah to an end. The same "age-old hostility" is charged against Edom in 35:5.

decisions.choice: Judah
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable name Judah as the one the Philistines wanted to destroy, which the Hebrew implies.

source.text: לָכֵ֗ן כֹּ֤ה אָמַר֙ אֲדֹנָ֣י יְהוִ֔ה הִנְנִ֨י נוֹטֶ֤ה יָדִי֙ עַל־פְּלִשְׁתִּ֔ים וְהִכְרַתִּ֖י אֶת־כְּרֵתִ֑ים וְהַ֣אֲבַדְתִּ֔י אֶת־שְׁאֵרִ֖ית ח֥וֹף הַיָּֽם׃

records.literal_gloss: therefore thus says [the] Lord Yahweh: Look, I [am] about to stretch out my hand against [the] Philistines, and I will cut off [the] Cherethites, and I will destroy the remnant of [the] coast of the sea.

en.L: therefore thus says the Lord {{divine_name:GOD|Yahweh}}: Look, I am stretching out {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} hand against the Philistines; I will cut off the Cherethites, and I will make the remnant on the seacoast perish.
en.B: therefore the Lord {{divine_name:GOD|Yahweh}} says this: I am about to stretch out {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} hand against the Philistines. I will cut off the Cherethites and destroy those who are left along the seacoast.
en.R: So this is what the Lord {{divine_name:GOD|Yahweh}} says: I am about to use {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} power against the Philistines. I will wipe out the Cherethites and destroy everyone who is left on the seacoast.

fr.L: c’est pourquoi ainsi parle le Seigneur {{divine_name:DIEU|Yahvé}} : Voici, j’étends {{deity_pronoun:ma|Ma}} main contre les Philistins, et je retrancherai les Kéréthiens, et je ferai périr le reste de la côte de la mer.
fr.B: c’est pourquoi le Seigneur {{divine_name:DIEU|Yahvé}} dit ceci : Je vais étendre {{deity_pronoun:ma|Ma}} main contre les Philistins. Je retrancherai les Kéréthiens et je détruirai ceux qui restent sur le bord de la mer.
fr.R: Alors voici ce que dit le Seigneur {{divine_name:DIEU|Yahvé}} : Je vais utiliser {{deity_pronoun:ma|Ma}} puissance contre les Philistins. Je ferai disparaître les Kéréthiens et je détruirai tous ceux qui restent sur la côte.

sw.L: kwa hiyo Bwana {{divine_name:MUNGU|Yahwe}} asema hivi: Tazama, ninanyosha mkono {{deity_pronoun:wangu|Wangu}} juu ya Wafilisti, nami nitawakatilia mbali Wakerethi, na kuwaangamiza mabaki wa pwani ya bahari.
sw.B: kwa hiyo hivi ndivyo Bwana {{divine_name:MUNGU|Yahwe}} asemavyo: Ninakaribia kunyosha mkono {{deity_pronoun:wangu|Wangu}} dhidi ya Wafilisti. Nitawakatilia mbali Wakerethi na kuwaangamiza wale waliobaki kando ya pwani ya bahari.
sw.R: Kwa hiyo hili ndilo Bwana {{divine_name:MUNGU|Yahwe}} analosema: Ninakaribia kutumia nguvu {{deity_pronoun:yangu|Yangu}} dhidi ya Wafilisti. Nitawaangamiza Wakerethi na kumwangamiza kila mtu aliyebaki pwani.

es.L: por tanto, así dice el Señor {{divine_name:DIOS|Yahvé}}: He aquí, yo extiendo {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} mano contra los filisteos, y cortaré a los cereteos, y destruiré el remanente de la costa del mar.
es.B: por eso el Señor {{divine_name:DIOS|Yahvé}} dice esto: Voy a extender {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} mano contra los filisteos. Eliminaré a los cereteos y destruiré a los que quedan en la costa del mar.
es.R: Así que esto es lo que dice el Señor {{divine_name:DIOS|Yahvé}}: Voy a usar {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} poder contra los filisteos. Acabaré con los cereteos y destruiré a todos los que quedan en la costa.

ko.L: 그러므로 주 {{divine_name:하나님|야훼}}께서 이와 같이 말씀하신다. 보라, 내가 블레셋 사람들 위에 내 손을 뻗어, 그렛 사람들을 끊어 버리고, 바닷가의 남은 자를 멸하겠다.
ko.B: 그러므로 주 {{divine_name:하나님|야훼}}께서 이렇게 말씀하신다. 내가 블레셋 사람들을 향해 내 손을 뻗으려 한다. 내가 그렛 사람들을 끊어 버리고, 바닷가에 남은 사람들을 멸망시키겠다.
ko.R: 그래서 주 {{divine_name:하나님|야훼}}께서 하시는 말씀이다. 나는 이제 내 힘으로 블레셋 사람들을 치겠다. 그렛 사람들을 쓸어버리고, 바닷가에 남아 있는 사람들을 모두 멸망시키겠다.

decisions.choice: the Cherethites: a people from Crete, part of the Philistines
decisions.reason: The Cherethites are named beside the Philistines in 1 Samuel 30:14 and Zephaniah 2:5. The name is generally linked with Crete, from which, with Caphtor, the Philistines came (Amos 9:7; Jeremiah 47:4).

decisions.choice: I will cut off the Cherethites: a play on sounds
decisions.reason: The verb "cut off" and the name "Cherethites" sound alike in Hebrew. The name itself announces their end.

decisions.choice: the remnant of the coast of the sea: those left after earlier defeats
decisions.reason: Assyria and Babylon had already struck the Philistine cities; what is left of them will now be destroyed (Jeremiah 47:4; Amos 1:8).

decisions.choice: Cherethites
decisions.reason: The name is spelled as in 1 Kings 1:38 and Zephaniah 2:5.

decisions.choice: "je retrancherai les Kéréthiens" (L, B), keeping the verb of 25:7 and 25:13
decisions.reason: French cannot keep the Hebrew sound play (*hikratti* / *keretim*); the meaning decision notes it. "Kéréthiens" as published 1 Chronicles 18:17.

decisions.choice: "Wakerethi"
decisions.reason: The form of the Swahili 1 Kings 1:38 and 1 Chronicles 18:17. The Hebrew sound-play ("cut off the Cherethites") cannot be kept in Swahili; the meaning decision explains it.

decisions.choice: cortaré a los cereteos (L)
decisions.reason: The Cherethites keep their published Spanish name (1 Kings 1:38); the Hebrew plays 'cut off' against 'Cherethites', which Spanish cannot keep, and the meaning decision says so.

decisions.choice: "그렛 사람들을 끊어 버리고"
decisions.reason: The published name 그렛 [1 Kings 1:38]; Korean cannot keep the Hebrew sound play between "cut off" and "Cherethites", which the shared meaning decision explains.

source.text: וְעָשִׂ֤יתִי בָם֙ נְקָמ֣וֹת גְּדֹל֔וֹת בְּתוֹכְח֖וֹת חֵמָ֑ה וְיָֽדְעוּ֙ כִּֽי־אֲנִ֣י יְהוָ֔ה בְּתִתִּ֥י אֶת־נִקְמָתִ֖י בָּֽם׃ס

records.literal_gloss: And I will do on them vengeances great with rebukes of wrath; and they will know that I [am] Yahweh, when I put my vengeance on them.

en.L: And I will execute great vengeance on them with rebukes of wrath; and they will know that I [am] {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, when I put {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} vengeance on them.
en.B: I will carry out great acts of vengeance on them and punish them in {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} wrath. Then they will know that I am {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, when I take {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} vengeance on them.
en.R: I will punish them severely in {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} anger. Then they will know that I am {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, when I pay them back for what they have done.

fr.L: Et j’exercerai sur eux de grandes vengeances par des châtiments de fureur ; et ils sauront que je [suis] {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, quand je mettrai {{deity_pronoun:ma|Ma}} vengeance sur eux.
fr.B: J’exercerai sur eux de terribles vengeances et je les châtierai dans {{deity_pronoun:ma|Ma}} fureur. Alors ils sauront que je suis {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, quand j’exercerai {{deity_pronoun:ma|Ma}} vengeance sur eux.
fr.R: Je les punirai sévèrement dans {{deity_pronoun:ma|Ma}} colère. Alors ils sauront que je suis {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, quand je leur ferai payer ce qu’ils ont fait.

sw.L: Nami nitatekeleza visasi vikuu juu yao kwa makaripio ya ghadhabu; nao watajua kwamba {{deity_pronoun:mimi|Mimi}} [ni] {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, nitakapoweka kisasi {{deity_pronoun:wangu|Wangu}} juu yao.
sw.B: Nitalipiza visasi vikuu juu yao na kuwaadhibu katika ghadhabu {{deity_pronoun:yangu|Yangu}}. Ndipo watajua kwamba {{deity_pronoun:mimi|Mimi}} ndimi {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, nitakapolipiza kisasi {{deity_pronoun:wangu|Wangu}} juu yao.
sw.R: Nitawaadhibu vikali katika hasira {{deity_pronoun:yangu|Yangu}}. Ndipo watajua kwamba {{deity_pronoun:mimi|Mimi}} ni {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, nitakapowalipiza kwa yale waliyoyatenda.

es.L: Y haré en ellos grandes venganzas con reprensiones de furor; y sabrán que yo [soy] {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, cuando ponga {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} venganza sobre ellos.
es.B: Ejecutaré en ellos grandes venganzas y los castigaré con {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} furor. Entonces sabrán que yo soy {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, cuando {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} vengue de ellos.
es.R: Los castigaré duramente con {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} enojo. Entonces sabrán que yo soy {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, cuando les haga pagar por lo que han hecho.

ko.L: 그리고 내가 진노의 책망으로 그들에게 큰 원수 갚음을 행하겠다. 그리고 내가 그들에게 내 원수 갚음을 내릴 때, 그들은 내가 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}인 줄 알 것이다.
ko.B: 내가 진노하여 그들을 벌하며 크게 원수를 갚겠다. 내가 그들에게 원수를 갚을 때, 그들은 내가 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}인 줄 알게 될 것이다.
ko.R: 나는 분노하여 그들을 크게 벌하겠다. 내가 그들이 한 일을 그대로 갚아 줄 때, 그들은 내가 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}인 줄 알게 될 것이다.

decisions.choice: rebukes of wrath: punishments that rebuke
decisions.reason: The word means a rebuke or reproof and is used of punishment that corrects and condemns (5:15; Psalm 39:12).

decisions.choice: when I put my vengeance on them: the chapter's last word
decisions.reason: The chapter closes on the word that runs through its second half. Those who took vengeance on Judah will meet the LORD's.

decisions.choice: and they will know that I am the LORD (L); Then they will know (B, R)
decisions.reason: The refrain follows the settled wording for Ezekiel; see the note at 6:7.
